Падал прошлогодний снег.info: Padal proshlogodniy sneg, "Last year's snow was falling", a Soviet claymation animated short. Highly recommend watching it, for the creative animation and cool score. It's available on YouTube, but here you can watch it with English subs.

Остров Сокровищ.info:
Ostrov Sokrovishch, "Treasure island" 1988, one of the many soviet adaptations of Treasure Island. Highly recommend watching it, for the very stylish animation and songs. There's official English localization, "Return to Treasure Island", but the voice acting is not as expressive, they replaced all the music and cut all the live-action song segments, which are half the fun. The original is available on YouTube, but you can watch episode 1 here and episode 2 here with very good English subs.
This directory contains the score, with a separate Songs subdirectory.

Funny story, originally there were no songs planned whatsoever, but when they were done with animation it turned out that the runtime was too short so they had to pad it somehow. And so they decided to cram in songs with live-action footage about just whatever, like how being greedy and smoking is bad, just to extend the runtime. But the songs are bangers nonetheless.

Приключения капитана Врунгеля.info: Priklyucheniya kapitana Vrungelya, "The Adventures of Captain Wrongel", a great piece of Soviet-Ukrainian animation, with a wild plot about sailing and spies, and great songs. Highly recommend watching it. You can watch it here with very good English subs.
